title: Calibration of exhaustive C5 reference capability under matched non-target state populations
question: Does matching the teacher's non-target training population to the evaluated M-dependent state population prevent the exhaustive target-retrieval collapse observed as M increases?
hypothesis: The M-dependent degradation of exhaustive target recall is partly caused by training the width-16 teacher on only 48 non-target codes while evaluation adds increasingly many decoys. A teacher trained on the same M-dependent non-target value distribution, while keeping all 16 target codes held out, should reduce the M-dependent recall decline.

arms.name: current_48
arms.intervention: current teacher training regime using the fixed 48 non-target codebook states

arms.name: matched_M_minus_16
arms.intervention: teacher training on the exact non-target values present in the evaluated M-level population

endpoints.name: exhaustive_target_recall
endpoints.description: fraction of evaluation tasks for which exhaustive cosine retrieval selects the target address

decision_rule.condition: At each registered M, report pooled exhaustive_target_recall for both arms and a seed-bootstrap 95% interval; at M=512, compute the paired seed-bootstrap 95% interval for matched_M_minus_16 minus current_48.
decision_rule.licenses: a workload-specific calibration result showing whether M-matched non-target teacher training materially changes the exhaustive reference capability.
decision_rule.does_not_license: selective-retrieval capability, a sparse-frontier win, semantic generalization beyond the tested code distribution, or asymptotic scaling.

decision_rule.condition: The preregistered materiality threshold at M=512 is a lower bootstrap bound above +0.10 for (matched_M_minus_16 - current_48).
decision_rule.licenses: material evidence that matched teacher-population exposure improves the exhaustive reference at the highest tested population.
decision_rule.does_not_license: that teacher calibration alone solves the sparse retrieval problem.

held_constant: teacher learning rate, margin, epochs, negative coverage, and optimizer implementation
target codebook remains CODEBOOK[:16] and is excluded from both training arms
exhaustive cosine scoring over all M states
protocol_note: Diagnostic study only. The current_48 arm reproduces the historical teacher exposure. The matched_M_minus_16 arm trains on the exact non-target state values present in the corresponding M-level evaluation population, which contains 48 fixed training codes plus M-64 decoys. All 16 target codes remain excluded from both training sets. The study does not modify or reinterpret TACOSM-C5-MULTIFACTOR-GRANULARITY-BEAM-FRONTIER-001.
